corpus_coverage: The inspected database contains Hansard chunks dated in 2025 only.
annotation_notes: All cases are drafts until a human explicitly approves them; only approved cases enter retrieval evaluation.
Gold chunk IDs are conjunctively required: every listed ID must occur in the top 10, while extra retrieved chunks are allowed.
Review every question, answerability label, corpus-absence reason, and evidence reference before reporting retrieval metrics.
expected_answer_points are preserved for other workflows but are outside the scope of this retrieval evaluation.
The database stores speaker and topic data in chunk metadata; date, house, and chamber are encoded in source_document_id rather than explicit filter columns.
